# anthropic_federation_issuer (Resource)

Manages an OpenID Connect (OIDC) federation issuer (`/v1/organizations/federation_issuers`) for Workload Identity Federation (WIF). Requires an `org:admin` OAuth access token (`oauth_token`) or `federation` authentication. Deleting this resource archives the issuer (`POST /v1/organizations/federation_issuers/{id}/archive`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_url` (String) Exact OIDC `iss` claim URL trusted by the organization (e.g. `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`).
- `jwks` (Attributes) Configuration for fetching JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS) to verify incoming JWT signatures. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jwks))
- `name` (String) Slug name of the federation issuer (`^[a-z0-9-]+$`, 1-255 characters).

### Optional

- `check_jti` (Boolean) Whether single-use `jti` replay tracking is enforced on JWT assertions. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_jwt_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Maximum allowed `iat`-to-`exp` lifetime in seconds (`1` to `176400`, defaults to `3600`).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the issuer was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the issuer was created.
- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier of the federation issuer (`fdis_...`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`federation_issuer`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the issuer was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--jwks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jwks`

Required:

- `type` (String) JWKS resolution strategy (`discovery` or `explicit_url`).

Optional:

- `ca_cert_pem` (String) Optional custom CA certificate PEM bundle for TLS verification.
- `discovery_base` (String) Optional override base URL for OIDC `.well-known/openid-configuration` discovery.
- `url` (String) Explicit JWKS endpoint URL when `type = "explicit_url"`.
